dog.description_text:
Meet Haymitch (aka Mitchy or Mitchell)! 🐶 Haymitch is a 3-month-old, 15-pound mixed-breed boy who’s equal parts brains, playfulness, and snuggles! This smart little guy is a quick learner and has already mastered “sit”, “lay down”, “come”, and “crate” in no time.

Haymitch loves playing with squeaky toys, working on a peanut butter-filled Kong, and showing off his playful puppy energy. But once playtime is over, he’s more than happy to curl up next to you on the couch or bed for some quality snuggle time.

He’s friendly with kids and other dogs, loves being carried in your arms or a sling, and is always excited for mealtime (or a treat!). He’s mastered pee pads, riding the subway, going potty outside, and is currently getting the hang of walking on a leash outdoors.

Haymitch is a clever, affectionate, fun-loving pup who will make a wonderful addition to a loving home. He’s ready to meet his forever family! ❤️

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
